newsitem.title: USA: PaineWebber names Masel head of credit research.
newsitem.headline: PaineWebber names Masel head of credit research.

text.p: PaineWebber Inc said on Wednesday that Randy Masel has been promoted to the newly created position of head of credit research at the firm.
A managing director, Masel previously headed PaineWebber's corporate bond research department, said the company.

The company said Masel's appointment will enhance the integration and coordination of its credit research departments -- high yield, corporate bond and emerging markets -- through the formation of a unified Credit Research department.
Succeeding Masel as head of corporate bond research, the company said, will be Joseph Labriola, previously with Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and Kidder, Peabody.
